title: findings.jsonl record
description: One verified finding per line. Append-only: a later line with the same id replaces the earlier one (full snapshot, higher rev). Candidates that fail verification are not written here; they are only counted in metrics.json.

round.description: Round in which the finding was first raised.

detail.description: What is wrong and why it matters, in two or three sentences.

origin.description: introduced: made in this round of work. source_material: already in the data or input material. inherited: follows from an upstream decision.

origin_decision.description: When origin is inherited: the upstream decision it follows from. Either this or caused_by is required.

fingerprint.description: Stable key (stage + anchor exact + problem kind) used so the same finding is never raised twice across rounds.

rule_ref.description: Rule or check that produced it, e.g. 'research-report/rules.md#R07' or 'checks/refusal_coding.py'.

class_of.description: Set when this finding is an instance found after the person marked a finding as 'a class of problem'.

replacement.description: Proposed replacement for anchor.exact, if the fix is a text edit.

apply_by_default.description: false for S3 wording issues: listed, not fixed, unless the person accepts.

finder.description: Reviewer role that proposed it, e.g. 'finder:measurement'.

verifier.description: Fresh-context agent that confirmed it against ground truth.

status.description: AI-side state. open: awaiting response. fixed: review-apply changed the artifact. closed: the person responded without a fix (reason is in feedback.jsonl). superseded: merged into another finding, or into a decision (for a plan, an open choice the person makes) — superseded_by names which. invalidated: its anchor or upstream decision no longer exists.

caused_by.description: Root-cause finding this one follows from (e.g. a wrong sample size caused by a parsing bug). The summary nests it under the root so one problem reads as one problem.

handoff_reason.description: Set during the AI revise loop when the AI cannot fix this itself (needs data it lacks, or a judgement only the person can make). The loop stops counting it; the page shows the reason.

note.description: How the page presents an open finding. suggest: worth changing, the author decides (default). verify: a fact must be checked against data, code or a source before the conclusion it affects can stand.
